name: Dispatch Check
buyer: Owner-dispatcher of a small field-service business scheduling 2–8 crews in a spreadsheet
trigger: A dispatch schedule CSV is ready for review before it is sent to crews
inputs: CSV with job_id,crew_id,start,end,window_start,window_end,buffer_minutes and explicit timezone offsets
accepted_output: Row-numbered crew overlaps, insufficient buffers, duplicate IDs, invalid timestamps and arrival-window exceptions; downloadable review CSV with no silent repairs
purchase_reason: A nonrenewing 30-day pass covering repeated schedule reviews; frequency and willingness to pay remain unvalidated
geography: English-speaking small field-service teams, initially US; explicit offsets supported
channel_hypothesis: Organic searches for crew schedule spreadsheet conflicts lead to a worked CSV guide and local checker; access unvalidated
acceptance_criteria: Conflicting crew rows identify both source row numbers; touching intervals pass unless buffer requires a gap
Strict explicit-offset timestamps reject impossible dates and ambiguous local times
Duplicate IDs, invalid durations and arrival-window violations produce actionable row reports
Editing inputs/settings invalidates results; reviewed downloads neutralize spreadsheet formulas
Public review deployment cannot create accounts or payments until durable capacity exists
kill_conditions: Fewer than three paying unrelated buyers each using three cycles without bespoke mapping
Support or acquisition exceeds five hours/week
Routing, urgent dispatch support or worker composition inference required
seo_intent: Check field service crew schedule CSV for double bookings and arrival-window violations
